title: global.json
description: Selects the .NET SDK and MSBuild SDKs for this folder and the folders below it.

version.patternErrorMessage: Expected an SDK version such as 10.0.100.

rollForward.description: How the version may roll forward when it isn't installed.

allowPrerelease.description: Whether preview SDKs may be selected.

paths.description: Folders searched for SDKs (`$host$` is the dotnet executable's folder).

errorMessage.description: The message shown when no SDK matches.

msbuild-sdks.description: Versions of MSBuild project SDKs, e.g. `"Microsoft.Build.Traversal": "4.1.0"`.
